title: Born With a Silver Spoon? Investigating Socioeconomic Bias in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper features a major component called 'Normative Judgement Evaluation' (Part 1 of the SILVER SPOON dataset), which is specifically designed to assess how LLMs handle ethical dilemmas and moral scenarios. It evaluates whether models judge actions as 'wrong' or 'right' in contexts of socioeconomic hardship, thereby benchmarking the model's ethical reasoning and moral judgment.
